## 4 Rent

Rent is payable monthly in advance by standing order.

files.tenancy/viewing-policy.md:
# Viewing policy

## Viewings

Viewings run weekdays 9am to 6pm with 24 hours notice to the tenant.

## Keys

Keys are released on the move-in date once the first month's rent clears.
